title: Anti-Hero

cues.en: I have this thing where I get older but just never wiser
cues.zh: 我有這樣的情況：我會變老，但永遠不會變得更聰明
cues.text: I have this thing where I get older but just never wiser

cues.en: Midnight's become my afternoons
cues.zh: 午夜變成了我的下午
cues.text: Midnight's become my afternoons

cues.en: When my depression works the graveyard shift all of the people
cues.zh: 當我的憂鬱症發作時，所有的人都會上夜班
cues.text: When my depression works the graveyard shift all of the people

cues.en: I've ghosted, stared there in the room
cues.zh: 我幽靈般地盯著房間裡
cues.text: I've ghosted, stared there in the room

cues.en: I should not be left to my own devices
cues.zh: 我不應該獨自一人
cues.text: I should not be left to my own devices

cues.en: They come with prices and vices, I end up in crisis
cues.zh: 它們帶來了價格和惡習，我最終陷入了危機
cues.text: They come with prices and vices, I end up in crisis

cues.en: This is all the time, I wake up screaming
cues.zh: 每次都是這樣，我尖叫著醒來
cues.text: This is all the time, I wake up screaming

cues.en: From dreaming one day I'll watch as you're leaving
cues.zh: 從夢想有一天我會看著你離開
cues.text: From dreaming one day I'll watch as you're leaving

cues.en: Cause you got tired of my scheming
cues.zh: 因為你厭倦了我的陰謀
cues.text: Cause you got tired of my scheming

cues.en: It's me, I'm on the problem, it's me
cues.zh: 是我，我是問題所在，是我
cues.text: It's me, I'm on the problem, it's me

cues.en: At tea, time, everybody agrees
cues.zh: 喝茶的時候，大家都同意
cues.text: At tea, time, everybody agrees

cues.en: I'll stand directly at the sun, but never in the mirror
cues.zh: 我會直接站在陽光下，但永遠不會站在鏡子裡
cues.text: I'll stand directly at the sun, but never in the mirror

cues.en: Must be exhausting, always rooting for the antihero
cues.zh: 一定很累，總是支援反英雄
cues.text: Must be exhausting, always rooting for the antihero

cues.en: Sometimes I feel like everybody is a sexy baby
cues.zh: 有時候我覺得每個人都是性感寶貝
cues.text: Sometimes I feel like everybody is a sexy baby

cues.en: And I'm a monster on the hill
cues.zh: 我是山上的怪物
cues.text: And I'm a monster on the hill

cues.en: Too big to hang out, slowly lurching toward your favorite city
cues.zh: 太大了，無法閒逛，慢慢走向你最喜歡的城市
cues.text: Too big to hang out, slowly lurching toward your favorite city

cues.en: You're still the heart, but never killed
cues.zh: 你依然是那顆心，但從未被殺死
cues.text: You're still the heart, but never killed

cues.en: Did you hear my covert narcissism
cues.zh: 你聽到我隱密的自戀了嗎
cues.text: Did you hear my covert narcissism

cues.en: Like disguises, altruism
cues.zh: 喜歡偽裝，利他主義
cues.text: Like disguises, altruism

cues.en: Like some kind of cause or spell
cues.zh: 就像某種原因或咒語
cues.text: Like some kind of cause or spell

cues.en: I wake up screaming from dreaming
cues.zh: 我從夢中尖叫著醒來
cues.text: I wake up screaming from dreaming

cues.en: One day I'll watch as you're leaving
cues.zh: 有一天我會看著你離開
cues.text: One day I'll watch as you're leaving

cues.en: It's me, I'm on the problem, it's me
cues.zh: 是我，我是問題所在，是我
cues.text: It's me, I'm on the problem, it's me

cues.en: At tea, time, everybody agrees
cues.zh: 喝茶的時候，大家都同意
cues.text: At tea, time, everybody agrees

cues.en: I'll stand directly at the sun, but never in the mirror
cues.zh: 我會直接站在陽光下，但永遠不會站在鏡子裡
cues.text: I'll stand directly at the sun, but never in the mirror

cues.en: Must be exhausting, always rooting for the antihero
cues.zh: 一定很累，總是支援反英雄
cues.text: Must be exhausting, always rooting for the antihero

cues.en: I have this dream, my daughter-in-law kills me for the money
cues.zh: 我有這個夢，我媳婦為了錢殺了我
cues.text: I have this dream, my daughter-in-law kills me for the money

cues.en: She thinks I left them in the will
cues.zh: 她認為我把它們留在遺囑裡
cues.text: She thinks I left them in the will

cues.en: Love family gathers around and reads it
cues.zh: 愛的家人聚集在一起閱讀
cues.text: Love family gathers around and reads it

cues.en: And then someone screams out
cues.zh: 然後有人尖叫起來
cues.text: And then someone screams out

cues.en: She's laughing up at us from hell
cues.zh: 她在地獄裡嘲笑我們
cues.text: She's laughing up at us from hell

cues.en: It's me, I'm on the problem, it's me
cues.zh: 是我，我是問題所在，是我
cues.text: It's me, I'm on the problem, it's me

cues.en: Everybody agrees, everybody agrees
cues.zh: 大家都同意 大家都同意
cues.text: Everybody agrees, everybody agrees
